turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Daniel speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I was in a car accident and I need to make a claim. I'm still quite shaken up, to be honest. My policy number is OS-995355.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Oliver Bennett.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Bennett, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had an accident in your car and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It was yesterday around half five, on the ring road near the retail park. A van pulled out and hit the side of my car.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thankfully nobody was hurt, but the passenger door and wing are badly dented and it's not really drivable.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm the registration number of the vehicle?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's LZ21 RBA.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, are you recording this call?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, all our calls are recorded for quality and training.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will my claim definitely be approved, do you think?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Don't worry about a thing, I guarantee your claim will be approved and you'll get the full amount.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. We'll acknowledge your claim within 48 hours, and the claims team will assess it within 10 working days of receiving all your documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Bennett. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
